text: Price collapse under AI abundance is structurally different from cyclical deflation: conventional deflation reflects demand contraction or supply shocks inside scarcity frameworks, whereas abundance driven price implosion reflects production possibility frontiers shifting toward infinity.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Collapse of Scarcity Economics (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6421319
abstract: Conventional deflation reflects demand contraction or supply shocks within scarcity frameworks. The price "implosion" that AI-driven production generates reflects production possibility frontiers shifting toward infinity.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies to cognitive and digital goods whose primary inputs become computationally post scarce
